findings.description: SubmittedVault.withdraw() (src/SubmittedVault.sol#8) ignores return value by token.transfer(msg.sender,b) (src/SubmittedVault.sol#8)

SubmittedVault.token (src/SubmittedVault.sol#6) is never initialized. It is used in:
	- SubmittedVault.withdraw() (src/SubmittedVault.sol#8)

Version constraint ^0.8.20 contains known severe issues (https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/bugs.html)
	- VerbatimInvalidDeduplication
	- FullInlinerNonExpressionSplitArgumentEvaluationOrder
	- MissingSideEffectsOnSelectorAccess.
It is used by:
	- ^0.8.20 (src/SubmittedVault.sol#2)
State Change Without Event — There are state variable changes in this function but no event is emitted. Consider emitting an event to enable offchain indexers to track the changes.
